import hashlib, json, pathlib, tomllib
root = pathlib.Path("coplay-cpa")
inputs = json.loads((root / "inputs.json").read_text())
inputs["BH-Unity-Harness/review/BUILD_CHECKPOINT.md"] = json.loads((root / "checkpoint-input.json").read_text())
matrix = json.loads((root / "ACTION_MATRIX.json").read_text())
records = []
for path, value in sorted(inputs.items()):
    raw = value["content"].encode("utf-8")
    actual = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode() + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()
    assert actual == value["sha"], path
    records.append({"path": path, "git_blob_sha": actual, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "bytes": len(raw)})
prefix = "Reference/CoplayDev/unity-mcp-beta/"
assert json.loads(inputs[prefix + "MCPForUnity/package.json"]["content"])["version"] == matrix["package_server_pair"]["unity"]["version"]
assert tomllib.loads(inputs[prefix + "Server/pyproject.toml"]["content"])["project"]["version"] == matrix["package_server_pair"]["server"]["version"]
for pin in matrix["source_schema_baseline"]:
    assert inputs[pin["path"]]["sha"] == pin["git_blob_sha"]
assert matrix["default_enabled"] is False and matrix["executable_configuration"] is False
assert matrix["enabled_observation_capabilities"] == [] and matrix["live_schema_digest"] is None
assert len(matrix["actions"]) == len({r["id"] for r in matrix["actions"]}) == 10
assert matrix["pilot_policy"]["max_items"] <= 200
assert "scope_paths" in inputs["BH-Unity-Harness/optional/unity-observation/unity_evidence.py"]["content"]
manifest = json.loads(inputs["BH-Unity-Harness/PACKAGE_FILES.json"]["content"])
assert len(manifest["files"]) == 25
assert sum(x["path"].endswith("/SKILL.md") for x in manifest["files"]) == 5
checkpoint = (root / "BUILD_CHECKPOINT.md").read_text()
assert "CP-B1 ONLY next:" in checkpoint and "B06a ONLY next" in checkpoint
result = {"task": "CP-A", "input_commit": matrix["input_commit"], "source_identity_result": "PASS", "sources": records, "document_consistency": "PASS: candidate versions, eight schema-source pins, disabled non-executable matrix, ten unique actions, BH item ceiling, installed roster and continuation", "runtime_tests": "NOT_RUN", "unity": "NOT_RUN", "native_provider": "NOT_IMPLEMENTED", "adoption": "PENDING", "command": "python coplay-cpa/validate.txt", "validator_source": (root / "validate.txt").read_text(), "artifact_hashes": {name: hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ("INTEGRATION_SPEC.md", "ACTION_MATRIX.json", "BUILD_CHECKPOINT.md")}}
(root / "RESULT.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
print("CP-A source identity checks: PASS (" + str(len(records)) + "/" + str(len(records)) + ")")
print("Document consistency checks: PASS")
print("Installed baseline: 25 files / five skills; capabilities disabled")
print("Runtime tests, native provider and Unity: NOT_RUN / NOT_IMPLEMENTED")
